name: NPHardEval
description: NPHardEval is a dynamic benchmark designed to evaluate the reasoning abilities of large language models across a broad spectrum of algorithmic questions up to the NP-Hard complexity class. It includes 900 questions representing a wide range of complexity classes below NP-hard and features a monthly update mechanism to reduce overfitting and provide a rigorous assessment of LLM reasoning capabilities.
reputation: A niche but notable dynamic reasoning benchmark introduced to probe NP-hard-level algorithmic reasoning in LLMs, with periodic updates intended to reduce memorization.
notes: Dynamic update mechanism with monthly data refresh to mitigate overfitting.
